# aphrody_ui crate

> Unified GPUI OS toolkit combining Iced-style reactive programs, Egui-style immediate inspectors/charts, and Libcosmic theme/config/nav abstractions with WCAG…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/aphrody_ui/

Unified GPUI OS toolkit combining Iced-style reactive programs, Egui-style immediate inspectors/charts, and Libcosmic theme/config/nav abstractions with WCAG AA verification.
